answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the wander of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The whisper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the trellis is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing.
